items.title: One switch, local or cloud.
items.detail: Built-in engines for 4, 8 and 16 GB GPUs (Ollama), Claude Haiku, DeepSeek, OpenAI and a local + Haiku hybrid.

items.title: Benchmark every cloud engine.
items.detail: DeepSeek has a smoke test and OpenAI none yet; each gets a full-pipeline quality run before it is recommended.

items.title: Re-run the local model bakeoff.
items.detail: The local tiers rest on the 2026-08-30 bakeoff; newer Ollama models get compared against the incumbents.

items.title: Supported tier for web and UI files.
items.detail: JavaScript, TSX, HTML, Vue, Svelte, Astro, ERB, XML UI files and Godot scenes pass the held-out bar.

items.title: More languages to supported.
items.detail: Python, Dart, Kotlin, C#, Rust and Swift run at the basic tier today.

items.title: Template languages with no scanner yet.
items.detail: HAML, Slim and MDX views are reported as not scanned.

items.title: New held-out rounds.
items.detail: Fresh third-party projects, labelled blind and scored once, before any tier changes.

items.title: Public repository and website.
items.detail: Source on GitHub and this site on GitHub Pages.

items.title: PyPI release.
items.detail: pip install llm_localizator (the command stays llm-localizator).

items.title: Translated review UI.
items.detail: German, French, Polish and Arabic UI catalogues completed.
